title: Git-folder sync S3: failure-mode tests and the five-task two-host pilot
outcome: Git-folder sync S3: failure-mode tests and the five-task two-host pilot
acceptance: Tests cover crash and lost reply, concurrent edit and ABA, feedless restored changes, malformed or partial folders, deleted dependencies, and native terminal/seal preservation

A five-task A plus B pilot (then 1K if available) shows safe changes genuinely applied and hard cases explicitly refused, with no claim of broad runtime convergence; host opt-in and setup stay explicit Greg acts
